| Finding | Line | Severity | Root Issue |
|---------|------|----------|-----------|
| Form input field for c24 | 179 | P0 | ForgeDsField reads user input instead of computing |
| Save stores empty/user value | 50 | P0 | `_v[8] ?? ''` instead of max computation |
| Card displays wrong value | 91 | P1 | Fetches stored (empty) instead of computing |
| CSV exports wrong value | 99 | P1 | Exports enum label instead of numeric max |
| Table displays wrong value | 191 | P1 | Fetches stored value instead of computing |

All defects confirm the police report: `calc ❌ (consts=1 calc=0)` — computed field declared but not implemented.
